Senior Software Engineer

Summary:
Senior software engineer leading React, Python, AWS, Docker, and Kubernetes solutions for IAMUS Consulting's DoD/IC missions. Driving architecture, delivery, security, and client technical leadership.
Senior software engineer leading full-stack, AWS, and secure DoD/IC mission solutions for IAMUS Consulting
Role description:
• Serve as the authoritative technical SME across frontend, backend, and cloud/DevOps domains
• Establish architectural direction, engineering standards, and technical goals aligned to project and mission objectives
• Make high-impact technical decisions and resolve complex, ambiguous implementation problems
• Design, build, and maintain responsive React frontends emphasizing usability, performance, and accessibility
• Develop secure, scalable Python backend services and APIs using FastAPI and/or Django
• Deliver clean, testable, maintainable code through code review, automated testing, and technical documentation
• Architect, provision, and manage AWS infrastructure using infrastructure-as-code practices
• Containerize applications with Docker and deploy, scale, and operate workloads on Kubernetes
• Design and maintain CI/CD pipelines, observability/monitoring, and automated deployment workflows
• Establish goals, roadmaps, and delivery plans
• Estimate level of effort and own task-level financial and schedule performance, including tracking burn against contract funding
• Define engineering methods, tooling, and processes and adapt them to mission and program needs
• Direct and control engineering activities for the client and ensure technical requirements are met
• Interface with client senior management and program stakeholders; negotiate scope, priorities, trade-offs, and delivery commitments
• Translate mission and operational requirements into technical strategy and communicate progress, risks, and options to leadership
• Provide technical leadership and mentorship
• Contribute to staffing decisions, resource planning, and team composition
• May supervise, direct, and review other engineers
• Champion secure-by-design and secure development practices in a CUI-handling, regulated environment
• Ensure software and infrastructure align with DoD/IC security requirements and organizational compliance obligations
Role requirements:
• SME-level mastery across React, modern JavaScript/TypeScript, Python backend development with FastAPI and/or Django, AWS, Docker, and Kubernetes
• Proven track record leading major software development or modernization efforts end-to-end, from technical planning through delivery and operation
• Experience directing technical activities and interfacing directly with senior client stakeholders, including negotiating scope, priorities, and technical direction
• Experience with level-of-effort estimation, resource/staffing planning, and ownership of task-level delivery
• Strong grounding in secure software development and cloud security practices
• U.S. citizenship
• Active U.S. security clearance or eligibility to obtain one at the level required by the program
• Ability to meet and maintain clearance eligibility requirements throughout employment
• Preferred: AWS GovCloud and/or FedRAMP or DoD Impact Level authorized environment experience
• Preferred: Infrastructure-as-code such as Terraform and Ansible and GitOps-style deployment workflows
• Preferred: Prior software delivery on DoD or Intelligence Community programs
• Preferred: Familiarity with CMMC, NIST 800-171/800-53, or comparable compliance frameworks
• Preferred: Relevant certifications such as AWS Solutions Architect/DevOps, Certified Kubernetes Administrator, Security+, or equivalent DoD 8570/8140 baseline
Benefits:
• Health insurance
• Life insurance
• Disability insurance
• Financial and retirement plans
• Paid leave
• Professional development
• Tuition assistance
• Dependent care
• Support for the team both in the office and beyond
Tech stack:
Ansible, AWS, Cloud, Django, Docker, JavaScript, Kubernetes, Python, React, Terraform, TypeScript
